title: Deploy context provider interface: pipeline deploy step builds deploy-context.json from the product link file (Upzi, VietnamWorks, future products)
requirement: Pipeline deploy step SHALL build deploy-context.json from a per-product provider (link file + converter chain) chosen through one interface, no manual --from-dir; deploy hold and recon report name the source; a new product is added by config, not code. REQ-0088 (RAW-00673, RAW-00675)
acceptance_criteria: AC2 auto build from link, meta source/link/sha, no placeholder
AC3 resumed run refreshed on provider change
AC4 hold/recon text names link or missing config
AC5 link secrets masked before context/slices
AC6 every user input mapped to a slot or out of scope
AC7 deploy-check verdict + hold text per product+plan
AC8 Upzi gateway calls mapped via upzi_service_route.txt, VNW byte-identical
AC10 built-context verdict + hard cost gate before phase0, reasoned waiver only, shown in reports
AC11 graph check before phase1 holds on 0 edges or >50% unresolved
AC12 deploy-context.json holds only the internal model; ingress/external gateways rewrite to it; validator reports violations
AC13 per-product path_rule full/partial/off; exposure.json from the public host/route inputs; overlay exposure per rule, conflicts counted, hiding never stricter than today

design.summary: Deploy provider in products.conf (deploy/gateway records); build_deploy precedence from-dir > PIPELINE_DEPLOY_DIR > provider > kubectl > none with meta source/link/sha; refresh on provider change; link-value secret masking (F-122-1); input inventory to slots; deploy_check.py --inputs (sufficiency) and --built (good/weak/empty quality verdict); hard cost gate before phase0 (only waiver --no-deploy-context --reason, never auto_scan, ignores PIPELINE_CHECKPOINTS=0); graph check before phase1; generalised Kong gateway rewrite (Upzi via upzi_service_route.txt, VNW byte-identical); RAW-00680 output contract = internal model only (Deployment+Service+ConfigMap per repo, in-cluster URLs, no gateway/vendor data), vendor-neutral gateway kinds ingress/external, GATEWAY_ROUTE key, contract validator 122.11; RAW-00681/00682 public exposure map exposure.json (122.12) with per-product path_rule (Upzi full, VNW partial), consumers overlay/correlate/reports
risks: wider deploy hold changes behaviour for pipeline plans with URL env keys and no context
link secrets reaching contexts before masking

implementation.summary: 122.1-122.12: provider records (deploy/gateway/exposure), build_deploy provider precedence (no kubectl fallback when off), masking, deploy_check.py --inputs/--built, contract filter+validator, hard phase0 cost gate + reasoned waiver, graph check, exposure.json + consumers, link_gateway_rewrite.py (VNW wrapper byte-identical), report lines, input-contract doc
